description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining an API for configuring UDP Echo settings in the TR-069 device IP diagnostics. It declares functions for setting enable flags, interface paths, and UDP ports related to UDPEcho configuration, along with associated documentation.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable flag for UDP Echo, enabling or disabling the service on the device.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Interface
methods.description: Sets the IP-layer interface over which the device listens for UDP echo requests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_UDPPort
methods.description: Sets the UDP port on which the device listens for and responds to UDP echo requests.
